name: Motion Count Up
description: KPI numbers that count up from zero when they scroll into view, formatted in the user's locale. One figure (partial) or a responsive row of figures (report).
helpText: Map Value to a numeric column, using a period as decimal separator. The final value is in the page markup, so screen readers, printing and users with reduced motion get it directly; the count-up only animates what is shown.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.helpText: Numeric value to count up to, for example 1284500 or 98.6. Use a period as decimal separator.

attributes.name: Label
attributes.helpText: Caption under the number, for example Orders this year.

attributes.name: Prefix
attributes.helpText: Text before the number, for example a currency symbol.

attributes.name: Suffix
attributes.helpText: Text after the number, for example %, k or SAR.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Optional Font APEX icon class, for example fa-shopping-cart.

attributes.name: Decimal Places
attributes.helpText: Digits after the decimal separator. Leave empty for whole numbers.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.helpText: How long the count takes. Leave empty for 1.6 seconds.

attributes.name: Accent
attributes.helpText: Colors the number and icon with the theme palette. Leave empty for the default text color.

attributes.name: Row Accent
attributes.helpText: Per-row accent from a column: primary, success, warning, danger (lower case). Any other value, or an empty one, falls back to the region's Accent setting. Example: case when overdue_count > 0 then 'danger' else 'success' end.
